name: NiceJob
oneLiner: Reputation marketing software for small service businesses that automates review requests, review widgets, referrals and repeat-customer campaigns from connected job and invoicing tools.
bestFor: Small home-service and local service businesses (cleaners, movers, trades) that want hands-off review collection; restaurants are not a stated focus.

updates.text: Partnered with SendJim so home-service businesses can print verified NiceJob 5-star reviews on direct-mail postcards.

features: Automatic review requests by email and SMS with follow-up reminders
Integrations with job and invoicing tools such as Jobber, Housecall Pro and QuickBooks, plus Zapier
AI review replies with adjustable tone, length and rules, including optional auto-reply (Pro)
Review widgets and social proof for your website
Referral campaigns that turn happy customers into referrers (Pro)
Repeat and rebooking campaigns plus marketing broadcasts (Pro)

pricing.text: Grow plan from $75/month for up to 2,500 customers a year ($95/month for 2,501–5,000); Pro plan from $125/month adds referrals, repeat campaigns, broadcasts and AI review replies. 14-day free trial, no contracts.

notes: Owned by Paystone since October 2021 (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20211013005280/en/). Current site is get.nicejob.com (the review links nicejob.com). Dropped: 'trusted by over 7,000 businesses' (NiceJob now claims 50,000+ locations on its own pages, unverified); the 'Reviews' plan name at $75 (now 'Grow'); the review funnel routing negative reviewers away from public sites (not confirmed in current materials, and review gating breaks Google's policies); 'Stories' feature and the NiceJob Sites '10% more website sales' guarantee (not confirmed). Pro $125 comes from NiceJob's LLM info page (May 2026). No restaurant customers found; NiceJob is built for home services, so it is a weak fit for a restaurant-reader post.
